_comment: レーンの背景画像のプロンプト（docs/ui/ScreenLayout.md レーンの背景 節）。
キーは <土地のobject_defの識別子>_<レーン> で、出力するファイル名と一致させる。
negative は sharedNegative + 各エントリの negativeExtra を繋いだもの。
設置物レーン（_fixture）はその土地の眺め、アイテムレーン（_item）は真上から見た地面。
後者は『構図のあるシーン』ではなく『一様なテクスチャ』を狙う。構図を作らせると中央に
道や開けた帯が生まれ、カードの下に何度も同じ模様が出て不自然になるため。
sharedNegative: path, trail, road, walkway, footpath, dirt track, opening, clearing, gap in the middle, corridor, vanishing point, central subject, focal point, symmetry, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, signature, artist signature, scribble, people, characters, animals, buildings, structures, high contrast, harsh shadows, vignette, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts

rocky_field_fixture.description: 岩場の眺め（設置物レーンの背景）。ごろごろした岩の連なりを目線の高さで見る。
rocky_field_fixture.positive: a field of weathered gray boulders and rock outcrops seen at eye level, evenly scattered rocks filling the whole frame edge to edge, dry cracked stone surfaces, patches of pale dry grass between the rocks, overcast diffuse daylight, muted gray and warm beige tones, soft watercolor painting, loose brushwork, flat even composition with no single subject, game background art
rocky_field_fixture.negativeExtra: cliff, mountain peak, cave entrance, single hero rock in the center

rocky_field_item.description: 岩場の地面（アイテムレーンの背景）。真上から見た砂利。一様なテクスチャに寄せる。
rocky_field_item.positive: extreme close-up macro texture of dry rocky ground seen from directly above, uniform layer of small gray gravel and coarse sand, evenly distributed with the same density everywhere, no large rocks, no arrangement, no composition, seamless natural ground texture, muted gray and warm brown tones, soft flat overcast light, soft watercolor painting, loose brushwork, game background texture
rocky_field_item.negativeExtra: large boulders, big rocks, rocks framing the edges, border of stones, rocky border, channel, riverbed, stream bed, arranged stones, stone wall, cobblestone pattern, outlined rocks, ink outlines, cartoon shading
